fields.text: Expressed the $\ge 1024$-byte contiguous blob pattern in Go's `regexp` package as `[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{512,}[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{512,}` and deferred $\ge 1024$-char hex strings from Layer 2 to Layer 4 because Go's RE2 engine caps `{min,max}` repeat quantifiers at `1000`.

Validated custom rules from `.memory/scrub.yaml` and `scrub.local.yaml` at the start of `Scrub` so malformed configs or forbidden keys (`allow`, `disable`, `whitelist`) fail closed deterministically even on empty strings.
